notes: v21: fixes all 8 P0s from Craig's QA — (1) feed-card like now updates in place optimistically (DB write + immediate rebind); (2) Insights panel shows session vs long-term signals — seen/opened/ignored/likes/dislikes/saves, top skipped tags, all on-device, nothing uploaded; (3) search actions update cards in place instead of re-running the query, so liked results no longer disappear; (4) similar posts are real card rows with thumbnails, titles, sources (no more debug-looking rows); (5) PDP dislike is icon-only (👎), state via activation; (6) hero image deduplicated from inline images; (7) PTR is remote-manifest-first — 5 quick previews then 5 silent (5+5), honest 'N new stories / caught up / inventory unreachable' result, no local-cache fallback; (8) thin/truncated bodies heavily demoted on-device (0.05 ranker multiplier) and server-side, with a grace window so fresh posts can still flesh out. Tag backfill now retries on partial shard failures instead of permanently marking done. New entertainment crawlers: AV Club, Collider, Screen Rant, Gothamist, Secret NYC, Atlas Obscura, Nomadic Matt (read-only, original-only, fail-closed; public comment feeds unavailable on these sources). The v18 bandit ranking keeps learning from likes/dislikes/saves/opens/deep-reads.
